shard_optimizer_with_fairscale: shard a fairseq optimizer using fairscale OSS for distributed training across GPU ranks
create_fairseqoss_subclass: create a FairseqOSS subclass that extends fairscale OSS with custom attribute forwarding and state broadcasting
broadcast_global_state_dict: broadcast the global optimizer state dict from rank 0 to all other ranks in a distributed group
disable_mem_eff_fp16_loading_hack: disable the memory efficient fp16 loading hack by setting the FairseqOSS property to True
forward_supports_attributes: forward supports* attribute calls from FairseqOSS to the underlying torch optimizer via __getattr__
